articles.title: License plate reader searches should require a warrant
articles.author: apwheele

zh.thesis: 历史车牌识别数据搜索应须司法令状，删除数据反而助长滥用。
points: 摄像头密度增加后，历史数据搜索迟早会被判需令状。
删除数据无法阻止警官反复搜索，反而阻碍长期调查。
需由第三方机构审计搜索记录，并明确非法搜索的处罚。

en.thesis: Searches of historical license plate data should require a warrant; deleting data would actually enable abuse.
points: With more cameras, warrantless searches of historical data will inevitably be ruled unconstitutional.
Deleting data can't stop officers from repeatedly searching and would hinder long-term investigations.
An independent third party should audit search logs and penalties for illegal searches must be clear.

articles.title: Roundup #86: Unintended consequences
articles.author: Noah Smith

zh.thesis: 多个经济与社会政策引发意想不到的后果，需重新审视其真正效果。
points: 劳动份额下降部分源于税收政策导致的收入重新分类，并非全是真实现象。
OPT外国毕业生增加促使本地企业创立，反而提高美国本地人就业和工资。
AI目前更多是互补而非替代，印度外包服务业反而因AI繁荣而增长。

en.thesis: Several economic and social policies have unintended consequences, requiring a re-examination of their true effects.
points: Part of the decline in the labor share stems from tax-induced reclassification of income, not all real.
More OPT foreign graduates spur local business creation, which raises native employment and wages.
AI is currently more complementary than substitutive; Indian outsourcing has boomed because of it.

articles.title: Abdul El-Sayed can win moderate voters
articles.author: Matthew Yglesias

zh.thesis: 左派候选人艾尔-萨耶德若走中间路线，可赢得温和选民并大胜。
points: 用「美国优先」框架谈以色列问题，比「武器禁运」更有说服力。
应在医保问题上创造渐进式改革的空间，而非教条化。
积极参与与温和派的团结活动，避免被党内派系工具化。

en.thesis: Left-wing candidate Abdul El-Sayed can win moderate voters and secure a landslide by taking a centrist line.
points: Framing Israel through an 'America First' lens is more persuasive than 'arms embargo.'
He should create space for incremental health care reform rather than being dogmatic.
Engage positively with moderates in unity events, avoiding being used by party factions.

articles.title: I Deleted My Calendar Link. And I’m Never Going Back
articles.author: JA Westenberg

zh.thesis: 删掉日历链接，主动拥抱摩擦，才能保住对时间的掌控。
points: 日历链接把时间变成了无限自助购物，削弱了主人的判断力。
无价值的人制造更多会议，会议数量与价值成反比。
接受来回协调的麻烦，会筛选出真正值得开的会。

en.thesis: Deleting my calendar link and embracing friction is the only way to keep control of my time.
points: Calendar links turn time into unlimited self-service shopping, eroding the owner's judgment.
People of low value generate more meetings; meeting count is inversely proportional to meeting value.
Accepting the hassle of back-and-forth scheduling filters for meetings that truly matter.

articles.title: Mistakes in financial economics
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 担心AI风险的人应该用真金白银买看跌期权来印证信念。
points: 花5千到1万美元买虚值看跌期权是低成本的信念检验。
多数担忧者在做多上很积极，却从不做空，暴露了真实想法。
市场不善于定价长期特殊风险，这恰是买期权的理由。

en.thesis: People worried about AI risk should put their money where their mouth is by buying put options.
points: Spending $5,000 to $10,000 on out-of-the-money puts is a low-cost test of conviction.
Most worriers are active in longs but never short, revealing their true beliefs.
Markets are bad at pricing long-tail risks, which is precisely the case for buying options.

articles.title: Tailscale Traces Database Corruption to 16y/o SQLite WAL-Reset Bug
articles.author: ropbear

zh.thesis: Tailscale历经六个月排查，发现并修复了一个潜伏16年的SQLite写入数据竞争缺陷。
points: 缺陷发生在检查点与写入事务并发时，导致页面被误认为已拷贝而丢失。
Tailscale因手动控制检查点并激进运行，比普通用户更易触发。
修复后四个月无事故，且意外暴露了一个表达式索引的次级问题。

en.thesis: After six months of investigation, Tailscale found and fixed a SQLite write-data-race bug that had lurked for 16 years.
points: The bug occurred when a checkpoint ran concurrently with a write transaction, causing pages to be mistakenly considered copied and then lost.
Tailscale triggered it more easily than typical users because it manually controls checkpoints and runs aggressively.
Four months post-fix with no incidents, and the work uncovered a secondary issue with an expression index.

articles.title: Why tiny JPEGs look different in Chrome
articles.author: gutechh

zh.thesis: Chrome渲染微小JPEG时只解码低频数据，导致图标显得更粗。
points: Chrome利用部分IDCT缩放，按1/8比例只解码低频系数。
这节省内存和计算，但丢失高频细节，使边缘变粗。
图标类图片不适合用JPEG，应改用SVG或PNG。

en.thesis: Chrome decodes only low-frequency data when rendering tiny JPEGs, making icons look bolder.
points: Chrome uses partial IDCT scaling, decoding only low-frequency coefficients at 1/8 resolution.
This saves memory and compute but loses high-frequency detail, thickening edges.
Icons are a poor fit for JPEG and should be SVG or PNG instead.

articles.title: Base Power Company: Chapter 3
articles.author: Packy McCormick

zh.thesis: Base Power以130亿美元估值融资，计划通过垂直整合成为最大能源公司。
points: 公司估值从4亿涨至130亿美元，目标指向万亿市值。
取消Gen 2电池，自研Gen 3，以掌握核心技术。
通过「制造、移动、存储、销售」框架向AI基础设施扩张。

en.thesis: Base Power is raising at a $13 billion valuation, with vertical integration aimed at becoming the largest energy company.
points: The company jumped from a $400 million to a $13 billion valuation, targeting a trillion-dollar market cap.
It canceled Gen 2 batteries to develop Gen 3 in-house for core tech control.
Its 'make, move, store, sell' framework is expanding into AI infrastructure.

articles.title: Immigrant Earnings Assimilation, 1981–2021
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 1990年代中期后到达的移民收入在十年内接近本地人，早期移民则不然。
points: 五分之一到三分之一的移民在十年内离开美国，返回者收入增长更慢。
永久移民的收入在十年内与本地人趋同或接近。
移民群的劳动市场质量改善和选择性返回是趋同加速的主因。

en.thesis: Immigrants arriving after the mid-1990s see their incomes approach natives within a decade, unlike earlier cohorts.
points: One-fifth to one-third of immigrants leave the US within ten years, and returnees see slower earnings growth.
Permanent immigrants' incomes converge or approach natives' within a decade.
Better labor market quality and selective return migration are the main accelerators of convergence.

articles.title: What makes people happy?
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 俄罗斯人幸福感在入侵乌克兰后上升，反映了战时国家认同的吸纳。
points: 幸福感上升在军工业地区更显著，在靠近前线地区则骤降。
这一模式难以用社会期望偏差解释，更像是真正的战时融入。
到2024年，数据缺失增加，幸福感指标的信息价值下降。

en.thesis: Russian happiness rose after the invasion of Ukraine, reflecting wartime national identity absorption.
points: The rise is sharper in military-industrial regions and plummets near the front lines.
This pattern is hard to dismiss as social desirability bias; it looks like real wartime integration.
By 2024, missing data increased, reducing the informational value of happiness measures.

articles.title: Someone is running mass vulnerability scans, spoofing AI bots like ClaudeBot
articles.author: gavinhking

zh.thesis: 攻击者伪装成ClaudeBot等AI爬虫，进行大规模漏洞扫描。
points: AI相关流量占机器人流量的28%，同比增长11%。
ClaudeBot和GPTBot等AI爬虫成为伪装目标，用于隐蔽扫描。
机器人流量总体下降2%，但AI类流量却上升。

en.thesis: Attackers are masquerading as AI crawlers like ClaudeBot to run large-scale vulnerability scans.
points: AI traffic is 28% of bot traffic, up 11% year over year.
Bots like ClaudeBot and GPTBot are being impersonated to hide scanning activity.
Overall bot traffic dropped 2%, but AI-related bot traffic rose.

articles.title: Google's AI found a Chrome bug hiding for 13 years, and it's only getting faster
articles.author: Rich Edmonds

zh.thesis: Google用专门AI智能体自动发现、修补Chrome漏洞，效率远超传统方法。
points: Chrome 149和150修复了1072个安全漏洞，超过前23个版本的修复总数。
AI智能体找出了潜伏13年的漏洞，并能生成候选补丁。
AI也能被攻击者利用，Google需加快更新节奏来缩小补丁窗口。

en.thesis: Google used a specialized AI agent to find and fix Chrome vulnerabilities far faster than traditional methods.
points: Chrome 149 and 150 fixed 1,072 security bugs, more than the prior 23 versions combined.
The AI agent uncovered a 13-year-old bug and generated candidate patches.
Attackers can also use AI, so Google must accelerate updates to shrink the patch window.

articles.title: I can't believe how good this AI coding model is, and it isn't from OpenAI or Anthropic
articles.author: Parth Shah

zh.thesis: Grok 4.5在编码效率上令人惊喜，虽非最强但token消耗极低。
points: 建站只用了约40k token，速度与成本优势明显。
简单改动时直接修改相关文件，不重复读取无关代码。
复杂任务仍不如Claude，但效率优势使其值得常驻。

en.thesis: Grok 4.5 surprises with coding efficiency; not the strongest, but its token usage is extremely low.
points: Building a site took only about 40k tokens, with clear speed and cost advantages.
For simple edits, it directly modifies relevant files without re-reading unrelated code.
Complex tasks still lose to Claude, but its efficiency earns it a permanent spot.

articles.title: Ep. #10, The System Is More Than the Code with Charity Majors
articles.author: Heavybit

zh.thesis: 在AI时代，代码变得可抛弃，系统架构与生产行为才是持久资产。
points: 观察力（可观测性）成为理解系统真实行为的核心。
生产环境是最终真相，胜过代码或文档。
AI使代码再生成本降低，但系统约束和用户承诺仍需维护。

en.thesis: In the AI age, code becomes disposable; system architecture and production behavior are the lasting assets.
points: Observability becomes the core of understanding how systems truly behave.
Production is the ultimate truth, more so than code or documentation.
AI lowers the cost of regenerating code, but maintenance of system constraints and user commitments remains.

articles.title: Delta
articles.author: khy

zh.thesis: Zed团队发布Delta，一个面向AI智能体协作编程的多人在线环境。
points: DeltaDB将对话与代码工作区实时同步，供多人协作。
界面以对话线程为中心，而非以编辑器为中心。
浏览器版通过WebAssembly和WebGL提供完整原生体验。

en.thesis: The Zed team has released Delta, a multiplayer environment for coding with AI agents.
points: DeltaDB syncs conversations and code workspaces in real time for collaborative work.
The interface centers on conversation threads, not on an editor.
The browser version delivers the full native experience via WebAssembly and WebGL.

articles.title: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
articles.author: wertyk

zh.thesis: Grok 4.6在智能指数上达到前沿水平，且成本远低于同类模型。
points: Grok 4.6智能指数61分，与GPT-5.6 Sol持平。
每任务成本0.84美元，是Claude Opus 5的三分之一以下。
长任务效率高，只需约53轮对话和0.5B输入token。

en.thesis: Grok 4.6 hits the frontier on an intelligence index at a fraction of the cost of similar models.
points: Grok 4.6 scores 61 on the intelligence index, tying GPT-5.6 Sol.
Its cost per task is $0.84, under a third of Claude Opus 5's.
On long tasks, it needs about 53 conversation rounds and 0.5B input tokens.

articles.title: New York is building. But where?
articles.author: Halina Bennet

zh.thesis: 纽约市长针对高价二套房的征税计划被法院暂停。
points: 史泰登岛法官下令暂停「空置豪宅税」的推行。
税改方案在实施前几天遭遇法律障碍。

en.thesis: A court has paused New York City's tax plan on expensive second homes.
points: A Staten Island judge ordered a halt to the vacant luxury tax.
The tax reform hit a legal hurdle days before it was set to go live.

articles.title: Grok 4.6
articles.author: iLuddite

zh.thesis: SpaceXAI发布Grok 4.6，主打长时运行智能体与视觉交互能力。
points: Grok 4.6在AA智能指数上追平GPT-5.6 Sol，达61分。
训练中使用了Grok 4.5重新生成SFT轨迹，并用模型检查过滤。
定价保持每百万输入2美元、输出6美元不变。

en.thesis: SpaceXAI unveiled Grok 4.6, focusing on long-running agents and visual interaction.
points: Grok 4.6 matches GPT-5.6 Sol at 61 on the AA intelligence index.
Training used Grok 4.5 to regenerate SFT trajectories, filtered by a model-based check.
Pricing stays at $2 per million input and $6 per million output tokens.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-2.4T
articles.author: Philpax

zh.thesis: 阿里发布Qwen3.8-2.4T，一个2.4万亿参数的开源MoE模型。
points: 模型总参数2.4T，激活参数95B，采用混合线性注意力架构。
在Deep Swe和SWE Bench Pro上分别得分56.6和67.7。
这是首次将Qwen-Max级模型开源，支持vLLM、SGLang等工具。

en.thesis: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-2.4T, an open-source MoE model with 2.4 trillion parameters.
points: The model has 2.4T total parameters, 95B active, using a hybrid linear attention architecture.
It scores 56.6 and 67.7 on Deep Swe and SWE Bench Pro, respectively.
This is the first Qwen-Max-class open source, supporting vLLM and SGLang.

articles.title: Fast Company covers New Aesthetics
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: Fast Company报道了「新美学」运动，艺术家成为故事焦点。
points: 文章将艺术家置于叙事中心，而非技术或策展人。
这一报道被经济学博客推荐，显示其文化影响力。

en.thesis: Fast Company profiled the 'New Aesthetics' movement, putting artists at the center of the story.
points: The article centers on artists rather than technology or curators.
This coverage was recommended by an economics blog, underlining its cultural impact.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
articles.author: explosion-s

zh.thesis: 无内容可评，仅从标题看是DeepSeek新模型的发布。
points: 标题显示为DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813的发布信息，但正文缺失。

en.thesis: No content to review—the title alone indicates a new DeepSeek model release.
points: The headline points to a DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 release, but the body is missing.

articles.title: Wednesday assorted links
articles.author: Tyler Cowen

zh.thesis: 经济学博客的链接汇总，涵盖意大利奶酪抵押品、丹麦增长等话题。
points: 意大利银行奶酪抵押品正在减值。
丹麦一半的增长来自一家公司。
外国旅游占美国消费支出1.4%，而中国进口商品占3%。

en.thesis: An economics blog's link roundup covers Italian cheese collateral, Danish growth, and more.
points: Italian banks are facing losses on cheese used as loan collateral.
Half of Denmark's growth comes from a single company.
Foreign tourism accounts for 1.4% of US consumer spending, while Chinese imports make up 3%.

articles.title: Tim King, AmigaDOS developer, has died
articles.author: doener

zh.thesis: AmigaDOS开发者Tim King逝世，他曾参与开发多任务操作系统Tripos。
points: King在剑桥大学开发Tripos系统，后被移植为AmigaDOS。
他后来创立Perihelion和ISP UK Online，对Amiga历史有重要贡献。

en.thesis: AmigaDOS developer Tim King has passed away; he worked on the Tripos multitasking OS.
points: King developed Tripos at Cambridge, later ported to become AmigaDOS.
He went on to found Perihelion and ISP UK Online, leaving a significant mark on Amiga's history.
